summary: First-finish smoke of Dokkaebi Shop. Verified backend auth/items/scenarios/grant/purchase/inventory/transactions and end-to-end frontend flow: admin login -> create item -> logout -> player login -> purchase -> inventory/log/scenarios pages. All critical flows working with sky-blue ORV theme.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates player and returns token
GET /api/auth/me returns current user with role/coins
POST /api/grant-coins updates player balance (0 -> 500) and writes tx
POST /api/purchase deducts coins (500 -> 400) and creates inventory row + tx
POST /api/purchase returns 400 'Not enough coins' when balance insufficient
GET /api/inventory returns purchased item snapshot for player
POST /api/scenarios (with scenario_type) creates main scenario visible_to=[] (all)
GET /api/scenarios as player returns broadcast scenarios
UI: admin login -> admin nav (Items/Players/Scenarios) visible
UI: admin item form creates item and it appears in shop grid
UI: player login -> header-coin-balance shows correct balance (400)
UI: admin nav hidden for player role
UI: buy-btn click deducts coins (400 -> 350) and creates tx row
UI: /inventory, /scenarios (Main Quest 1 visible), /log (3 tx rows) all load
notes: Scenario API field is 'scenario_type' (not 'type') - frontend uses correct field name.
Image upload endpoint /api/upload not exercised in this smoke - defer to full testing.
Edit/delete flows for items and scenarios not clicked through UI but backend routes exist; defer to full testing.
Filter by category/rank not clicked through UI in this smoke.
